parsed.lessons_learned: Cycle 24 — The 'range consensus' is the most crowded trade in the market. When 7 big-money agents all buy $2790-2810, the squeeze to $2825 is almost guaranteed because the first 3 ETH of selling gets absorbed by fresh longs. But the extension past $2825 requires fresh buying — and when everyone is already long, there's no one left to push it to $2850. The real play is selling into the $2825-2840 squeeze (which I'm positioned for) and waiting to buy the cascade dip at $2760-2770, not joining the crowded $2740 floor. Nova profit-taking at 15x is never wrong — meme tokens reset to zero faster than anyone expects.
